node.title: Re: perlcritic compliant way to eval?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [KeighleHawk],

The default [mod://Perl::Critic] doesn't seem to have a policy against the "[doc://do] FILE" form of invoking code.

But [mod://Perl::Critic] is also just a set of hints that are sometimes very helpful, but sometimes the programmer knows better. If you know what you're doing with [doc://eval] (security-wise etc.), I see no problem with sticking a ## no critic (ProhibitStringyEval) on that line.

Lastly, if I may shamelessly plug one of my own modules, see my post from a little while ago: [id://1167085], depending on what your data files look like it might work for you.

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
